name: Lockerbie Bombing
summary: A bomb destroyed Pan Am Flight 103, killing 270 people.

name: Iran–Iraq War Ends
summary: A ceasefire ended the long Iran–Iraq War.

name: Seoul Olympics
summary: South Korea hosted the Summer Olympics.

name: Soviet Withdrawal from Afghanistan Begins
summary: The USSR began withdrawing troops from Afghanistan.

name: Benazir Bhutto Elected
summary: Bhutto became the first female leader of a Muslim-majority country.

name: IPCC Established
summary: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change was created.
